description: Source code for managing WPA Supplicant configuration files, including creation, updating, and setting network/global parameters, with functions for handling security modes, credentials, and configuration file I/O.

methods.name: s_addMLOFreqCandidates
methods.description: Adds frequency candidates for MLO (Multi-Link Operation) by printing possible frequencies from radio and neighbor links.

methods.name: s_setWpaSuppGlobalConfig
methods.description: Sets global configuration parameters for wpa_supplicant based on endpoint and configuration data.

methods.name: s_setPsk
methods.description: Sets the PSK (Pre-Shared Key) in the network configuration, optionally hashing the passphrase.

methods.name: s_setSaePassword
methods.description: Sets the SAE (Simultaneous Authentication of Equals) password in the network configuration.

methods.name: s_setWpaSuppNetworkConfig
methods.description: Configures network-specific parameters for wpa_supplicant based on endpoint profile and security mode.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_create
methods.description: Creates a wpa_supplicant configuration file for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_createExt
methods.description: Creates a wpa_supplicant configuration file using existing endpoint's wpaSupp data.

methods.name: s_cfgFile_update
methods.description: Updates a specific key-value pair in a configuration file, either global or network section.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_globalConfigUpdate
methods.description: Updates a global configuration parameter in the wpa_supplicant config file.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_networkConfigUpdate
methods.description: Updates a network-specific configuration parameter in the wpa_supplicant config file.
